description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class PassengerResponse for encapsulating passenger information in API responses.

classes.name: PassengerResponse
classes.description: A DTO class representing passenger details including ID, contact info, biometric info, KYC status, and verification timestamp.

methods.name: getPhoneE164
methods.description: Retrieves the passenger's phone number in E.164 format.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Retrieves the passenger's date of birth.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the passenger's date of birth.

methods.name: getAadhaarLast4
methods.description: Retrieves the last four digits of Aadhaar.

methods.name: setAadhaarLast4
methods.description: Sets the last four digits of Aadhaar.

methods.name: getKycVerifiedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when KYC was verified.

methods.name: setKycVerifiedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when KYC was verified.
